name: signature-pad
title: Signature Pad
description: A canvas to sign on with mouse, touch or pen. Ink is sprung and thins with speed; the result comes out as SVG.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after each stroke, undo or clear with the signature as SVG, or null once it is empty.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the drawing area.
